versions.changelog: Remove personal/project-specific names from examples and helpers: generic profile fallback in scripts/_lib.sh and neutral channel/agent names in SKILL.md. No behavior change.

Initial release. The mutation half of the post-update pair: syncs drifted plugins, restarts the gateway, snapshots channel health pre/post, and applies a JSON patch removing stale plugins.entries.<id> nodes from openclaw.json. Every mutation is dry-run by default, backed up, restored on post-mutation gateway unhealth. Requires post-update-awareness >= 0.3.1.
